reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. Our dashboard did show TRF-INV-88 as failed, but we checked directly with Access Bank for the final status, and the bank confirms the transfer of ₦250,000 was successful and credited to your account (0234567891) on 21 November 2026 at 14:02.

Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Our system simply hadn't updated its status, which is why it looked like a failure on our side. Because the money has already reached your account, we won't resend it — doing so would result in a duplicate payment.

Please check your account statement for the credit on 21 November. If you genuinely can't find it, get back to us with the details and we'll investigate with the bank right away.

Apologies for the confusion and the delay in confirming this.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations
